{"schema_version":"company_profile_workpaper_draft.v1","elements":{"business_structure":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F01","text":"公司为综合性跨区域经营的民营建筑企业，1995年在深圳证券交易所主板上市，长期深耕基础设施和建筑工程建设领域，主营业务涵盖工程施工及相关配套服务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"]},{"fact_id":"F02","text":"公司报告分部包括福建美丽生态业务及其他业务；福建美丽生态业务对应福建美丽生态建设集团有限公司的业务，其他业务为除该公司以外的业务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0014","source-0015"]},{"fact_id":"F03","text":"公司下属公司拥有市政公用工程施工总承包壹级、建筑工程施工总承包壹级、公路工程施工总承包贰级、水利水电工程施工总承包贰级、电力工程施工总承包贰级、隧道工程专业承包壹级等多项施工资质，在市政公用工程、公路工程、建筑工程、电力工程、水利工程、园林绿化等领域具备施工承揽能力。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"]}]},"products_services":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F04","text":"公司主营业务涵盖工程施工及相关配套服务，持续参与市政公用、公路、铁路、水利水电、工业与民用建筑及电力工程等领域建设。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"]},{"fact_id":"F05","text":"按产品划分，公司收入来自工程项目、算力业务、工程材料销售收入、其他收入及苗木销售；其中工程项目收入563,957,935.12元，占营业收入比重88.93%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"],"metrics":[{"name":"工程项目营业收入","raw_value":"563,957,935.12","value":"563957935.12","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"工程项目营业收入占营业收入比重","raw_value":"88.93","value":"88.93","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F06","text":"苗木销售收入38,967,251.38元，占营业收入比重6.14%；工程材料销售收入29,920,637.78元，占4.72%；算力业务收入1,221,071.95元，占0.19%；其他收入145,034.32元，占0.02%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"],"metrics":[{"name":"苗木销售收入","raw_value":"38,967,251.38","value":"38967251.38","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"苗木销售收入占营业收入比重","raw_value":"6.14","value":"6.14","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"工程材料销售收入","raw_value":"29,920,637.78","value":"29920637.78","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"工程材料销售收入占营业收入比重","raw_value":"4.72","value":"4.72","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"算力业务收入","raw_value":"1,221,071.95","value":"1221071.95","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"算力业务收入占营业收入比重","raw_value":"0.19","value":"0.19","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他收入","raw_value":"145,034.32","value":"145034.32","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他收入占营业收入比重","raw_value":"0.02","value":"0.02","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"revenue_model":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F07","text":"报告期内公司实现营业收入634,211,930.55元，较同期下降24.69%；实现归属于上市公司股东的净利润-34,564,363.86元，较同期下降296.15%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0003"],"metrics":[{"name":"营业收入","raw_value":"634,211,930.55","value":"634211930.55","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"营业收入同比增减","raw_value":"-24.69","value":"-24.69","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"归属于上市公司股东的净利润","raw_value":"-34,564,363.86","value":"-34564363.86","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"归属于上市公司股东的净利润同比增减","raw_value":"-296.15","value":"-296.15","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F08","text":"工程项目营业收入563,957,935.12元，营业成本512,055,737.51元，毛利率9.20%，营业收入比上年同期增减-4.61%，营业成本比上年同期增减1.98%，毛利率比上年同期增减-5.88%。","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0005"],"metrics":[{"name":"工程项目营业成本","raw_value":"512,055,737.51","value":"512055737.51","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"工程项目毛利率","raw_value":"9.20","value":"9.20","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"工程项目毛利率比上年同期增减","raw_value":"-5.88","value":"-5.88","unit":"百分点","currency":null,"source_unit":"%","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F09","text":"公司营业成本合计584,998,287.97元，其中工程项目成本512,055,737.51元占87.53%，工程材料销售收入成本35,754,986.54元占6.11%，苗木销售成本37,112,092.23元占6.34%，算力业务成本75,471.69元占0.01%，其他收入成本0.00元占0.00%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0006","source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"营业成本合计","raw_value":"584,998,287.97","value":"584998287.97","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"工程项目成本占营业成本比重","raw_value":"87.53","value":"87.53","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"工程材料销售收入成本","raw_value":"35,754,986.54","value":"35754986.54","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"苗木销售成本","raw_value":"37,112,092.23","value":"37112092.23","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"算力业务成本","raw_value":"75,471.69","value":"75471.69","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他收入成本","raw_value":"0.00","value":"0.00","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"scale_and_mix":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F10","text":"分地区看，华南地区营业收入348,921,315.39元占55.02%，西南地区173,538,599.47元占27.36%，华中地区73,128,372.30元占11.53%，华东地区37,158,003.05元占5.86%，华北地区1,397,370.23元占0.22%，西北地区68,270.11元占0.01%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"],"metrics":[{"name":"华南地区营业收入","raw_value":"348,921,315.39","value":"348921315.39","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"华南地区营业收入占营业收入比重","raw_value":"55.02","value":"55.02","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"西南地区营业收入","raw_value":"173,538,599.47","value":"173538599.47","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"西南地区营业收入占营业收入比重","raw_value":"27.36","value":"27.36","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"华中地区营业收入","raw_value":"73,128,372.30","value":"73128372.30","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"华中地区营业收入占营业收入比重","raw_value":"11.53","value":"11.53","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"华东地区营业收入","raw_value":"37,158,003.05","value":"37158003.05","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"华东地区营业收入占营业收入比重","raw_value":"5.86","value":"5.86","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F11","text":"分部信息显示，福建美丽生态业务营业收入523,128,652.08元，其他业务营业收入111,277,874.84元，分部间抵销-194,596.37元，合计634,211,930.55元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0015"],"metrics":[{"name":"福建美丽生态业务营业收入","raw_value":"523,128,652.08","value":"523128652.08","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"其他业务营业收入","raw_value":"111,277,874.84","value":"111277874.84","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"business_segment","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"分部间抵销营业收入","raw_value":"-194,596.37","value":"-194596.37","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F12","text":"主要子公司福建美丽生态建设集团有限公司主要业务为市政基础设施建设、建筑施工及公路工程，注册资本506,880,000.00元，总资产2,504,993,898.09元，净资产169,263,013.31元，营业收入523,128,652.08元，营业利润62,513,523.79元，净利润21,252,059.49元。","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0010"],"metrics":[{"name":"福建美丽生态建设集团有限公司营业收入","raw_value":"523,128,652.08","value":"523128652.08","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"福建美丽生态建设集团有限公司净利润","raw_value":"21,252,059.49","value":"21252059.49","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"named_subsidiary","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"operations_and_inputs":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F13","text":"公司通过专业分包、总承包、劳务分包等业务模式开展工程施工；报告期内完工（已竣工验收）项目专业分包6个，项目金额1,288,666,442.46元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0005"],"metrics":[{"name":"完工项目专业分包项目数量","raw_value":"6.00","value":"6.00","unit":"个","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"完工项目专业分包项目金额","raw_value":"1,288,666,442.46","value":"1288666442.46","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F14","text":"报告期内未完工项目中，总承包7个、项目金额3,852,408,196.89元；专业分包31个、项目金额6,124,679,082.92元；劳务分包23个、项目金额13,079,202,276.22元。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0005"],"metrics":[{"name":"未完工总承包项目数量","raw_value":"7.00","value":"7.00","unit":"个","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"未完工总承包项目金额","raw_value":"3,852,408,196.89","value":"3852408196.89","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"未完工专业分包项目数量","raw_value":"31.00","value":"31.00","unit":"个","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"未完工专业分包项目金额","raw_value":"6,124,679,082.92","value":"6124679082.92","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"未完工劳务分包项目数量","raw_value":"23.00","value":"23.00","unit":"个","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"未完工劳务分包项目金额","raw_value":"13,079,202,276.22","value":"13079202276.22","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F15","text":"前五名供应商合计采购金额294,462,766.14元，占年度采购总额比例55.55%；前五名供应商采购额中关联方采购额占年度采购总额比例0.00%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0008"],"metrics":[{"name":"前五名供应商合计采购金额","raw_value":"294,462,766.14","value":"294462766.14","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"前五名供应商合计采购金额占年度采购总额比例","raw_value":"55.55","value":"55.55","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"customers_channels_markets":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F16","text":"前五名客户合计销售金额522,091,856.99元，占年度销售总额比例82.33%；前五名客户销售额中关联方销售额占年度销售总额比例0.00%。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"前五名客户合计销售金额","raw_value":"522,091,856.99","value":"522091856.99","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"前五名客户合计销售金额占年度销售总额比例","raw_value":"82.33","value":"82.33","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F17","text":"公司积极与大型央企及国有企业开展业务合作，通过项目协作、资源共享等方式参与多项重点工程建设；并与众多央企、国企、金融机构建立了战略合作关系。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"]},{"fact_id":"F18","text":"公司持续将市场重心放在粤港澳大湾区、江浙地区、长三角区域及川渝地区等经济活跃区域，并适度收缩风险较高区域业务。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0003"]}]},"operating_drivers":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F19","text":"公司坚持优化订单结构，强化项目筛选机制，优先选择资金来源明确、履约条件较好的项目；同时有序拓展新能源工程、大数据算力配套等相关领域业务，作为主营业务的延伸补充。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0004"]},{"fact_id":"F20","text":"管理费用8,198,300.03元，较上年同期下降90.51%，主要系本期业绩未实现，冲回原计提的股权激励费用；财务费用77,760,763.89元，较上年同期增长45.81%，主要系判决后未付款增加了延期支付利息。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0008"],"metrics":[{"name":"管理费用","raw_value":"8,198,300.03","value":"8198300.03","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"管理费用同比增减","raw_value":"-90.51","value":"-90.51","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"财务费用","raw_value":"77,760,763.89","value":"77760763.89","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"},{"name":"财务费用同比增减","raw_value":"45.81","value":"45.81","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]},{"fact_id":"F21","text":"经营活动产生的现金流量净额-8,038,799.29元，较上期减少主要系上期受国家化债政策红利、公司项目回款本期减少。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0008","source-0009"],"metrics":[{"name":"经营活动产生的现金流量净额","raw_value":"-8,038,799.29","value":"-8038799.29","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"material_changes":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F22","text":"2025年12月，公司将原持有美丽生态科技（深圳）有限责任公司51%股权转让给共青城鑫明投资中心（有限合伙），转让后不再持有其股权，不再纳入合并范围；本期注销深美商贸（浙江）有限责任公司、美丽生态科技（北京）有限责任公司2家子公司。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0007"]},{"fact_id":"F23","text":"公司报告期内业务、产品或服务发生重大变化或调整情况为不适用。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0007"]},{"fact_id":"F24","text":"公司工程施工作资资质在报告期内有部分提升，依据近期业绩积累及国家工程资质相关改革政策激励。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002"]}]},"company_features":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F25","text":"公司作为民营建筑企业，在专业化施工、区域深耕及灵活机制方面具备一定竞争优势；但在业务规模、资金实力及资源整合能力等方面与行业龙头企业相比仍存在差距。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002","source-0012"]},{"fact_id":"F26","text":"公司面临工程实施所形成的合同资产余额较大的风险：部分项目在未与业主计价结算前形成合同资产，结算后转为应收账款逐步回款；同时部分工程需垫付较多资金、回款周期较长，存在应收款项不能按时回收的风险。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0013"]}]}},"supply_chain":{"position":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F27","text":"公司主营业务涵盖工程施工及相关配套服务，在建筑产业链中承担施工承包角色，通过专业分包、总承包、劳务分包等模式参与项目建设。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002","source-0005"]}]},"upstream_inputs":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F28","text":"公司前五名供应商合计采购金额294,462,766.14元，占年度采购总额比例55.55%，但报告未披露具体采购材料或资源类别。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0008"],"metrics":[{"name":"前五名供应商合计采购金额","raw_value":"294,462,766.14","value":"294462766.14","unit":"元","currency":"CNY","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}],"downstream_customers":{"status":"observed","facts":[{"fact_id":"F29","text":"公司客户以大型央企及国有企业为主，通过项目协作参与重点工程建设；前五名客户合计销售金额占年度销售总额比例82.33%，客户集中度较高。","subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","evidence_ids":["source-0002","source-0007"],"metrics":[{"name":"前五名客户合计销售金额占年度销售总额比例","raw_value":"82.33","value":"82.33","unit":"%","currency":null,"subject_scope":"consolidated_group","period":"2025年度","qualifier":"exact"}]}]},"limitations":["未获取成功：报告未披露各业务板块的毛利率明细（除工程项目外），苗木销售、工程材料销售、算力业务等分项毛利率无法计算。","未获取成功：报告未披露主要客户及供应商的具体名称，仅以单位一至单位五列示。","未获取成功：报告未披露公司具体采购的原材料或资源类别明细。","未获取成功：报告未披露算力业务的具体服务内容与客户。"]}
